items.title: Ohio casino regulator orders its licensees to stop serving unlicensed prediction market operators, RG reports
items.content_text: - **Ohio casino regulator orders its licensees to stop serving unlicensed prediction market operators, RG reports** — RG reports the Ohio Casino Control Commission sent a letter on October 20 telling sports gaming and fantasy contest licensees to immediately stop providing services such as liquidity, market making and integrity monitoring to unlicensed event-contract operators. Licensees must notify the commission of compliance by October 30 and face suitability investigations or possible license suspension or revocation if they do not comply. ([RG](https://rg.org/news/prediction-markets/ohio-warns-gaming-licensees-prediction-market-services))
